notes.title: Hello from the 90's
notes.notes:
After the release of the game, there has already been enough time, I can sum up some results based on my feelings and feedback from the players.

Unfortunately, the beginning of the game turned out to be banal, and then the player learns that the plot is given in the form of text ... But, believe me, the further, the more interesting, and this is not only my opinion. I did not set myself the goal of quickly scare the player, and tried to slowly immerse the player in an atmosphere of despair and horror.

Walkthrough of the game takes effort - slowly, it is not clear, a lot of text - a true "Hello from the 90's". Mistfal turned out that way, because I myself played similar games when I was a teenager:)

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Halloween is coming![/h1]
Specially for Halloween I've prepared a grand update package:
[List]
     [*] Trading cards
     [*] New horror elements
     [*] Lighting system changed, new visual effects added
     [*] New sound effects
     [*] Bugs fixed
[/List]
The game became more scary and dynamic. And what else do you need in the dark autumn evenings;)

notes.title: Greetings !
notes.notes:
Mistfal went into release, after 3 years of development. Thank you to everyone who supported me. I made this game alone, it was not easy.
Important !
I want to warn - Mistfal is not for everyone. In the game there is not a lot of fun and screamers. It is for smart and patient players (I believe that they exist) who are willing to forgive some roughness for good deep story.
If you are ready, Welcome!
